Name: Better Pigs and Recolours
Author: Zhuria
Description:
[size=3][b][color=#00ff00]NOTE: Variations are fixed and finally working thanks to help from TheLimeyDragon! If you had the mod installed and variations enabled, your pigs will now be correctly assigned their skins retroactively.[/color][/b]

This mod includes retextured pigs in 8 recolours, plus one pink "smooth vanilla" pig that's just the vanilla pig with less wrinkles and looking slightly happier.
[/size]
[size=3]You can set your default pig colour (pigs from old saves will use these skins) and enable variations that will be randomly assigned to any cow that is born or purchased.[/size]

[size=5][u][u][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size][/u][/u][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size]
[*][size=3](optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ for easy config setting management[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=3][b][u]Troubleshooting[/u][/b]
If SMAPI is saying you have missing textures, or pigs are showing up purple or green, this could be an issue with Alternative Textures. Check in your AT mod (or general Mods) folder to see if the [AT] Example pack folder is present; if so, you'll have to delete it.
[/size][size=3]---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/size]

[size=3]This mod includes two pig styles with varying amounts of changes made.

[b][u]Version 2.1[/u] (in 8 colours)[/b][b] [/b]is a more drastic edit where I have still tried to stay true to the vanilla textures but have gone for a more realistic look. Baby pigs included!

[u]Version 1.0[/u] ("Smooth Vanilla") replaces the vanilla adult pig with one that looks happier and less lumpy. If you think the vanilla pig looks like it hates everything about life but don't want to stray too far from vanilla, give this a try. The baby is kept vanilla. Disabled by default.[/size]
